collection_method: Official UI query after authorized Geetest; normal UI pagination; visible seven-cell table rows only. No verification credentials captured.
coverage_contract: Complete returned query pages for captured currency/date pairs; not a claim that BOC retains every originally published quote. Pending pairs are not filled with interpolated or current prices.
storage_contract: Existing bare-array schema and continuous five-price-run dedup, except independently rechecked same-second differing five-price tuples are all kept in stable source order; exact timestamp/price repeats removed; original repeated rows preserved in raw evidence; existing daily files never overwritten.

captures.same_second_policy: Keep every distinct five-price tuple in stable official source order; remove identical timestamp/price duplicates. Other continuous price-run compression unchanged.
